publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey
table: Table 1. Time spent in primary activities and percent of the civilian population engaging in each activity, averages per day by sex
title: Socializing and communicating on an average day
universe: Civilian noninstitutional population 15 years and over
limits: ATUS socializing and communicating is any face-to-face socializing (household members, visitors, events), not only a visit to someone outside the home; the game's visit is one contact act with a tie. National only: ATUS publishes no state rows. The band is the range across the table's own sex cohorts; it checks the town's share of adult-days with a visit and is never a chance any person acts on.
